signals.text: 5 open PM roles across 2 US offices
5 new PM roles posted this week

bullets: Owner: You act like your name is on the door. If something is broken, you feel responsible for fixing it, even if it’s outside of your swim lane.
First principles thinker: You break ambiguous problems into clear hypotheses, and your instinct is to ask "What are we trying to accomplish here?" before jumping to "What is the…
Tenacious: You are highly resilient. No challenge is too difficult, no issue unsolvable.
Sense of urgency: You have a strong bias for action and are impatient when progress is stalled.
0-to-1 scope: The products you will work on are new territory for us. There are no established frameworks, no prior PM who has figured it out.
Product complexity: Property tax rules vary county by county. Specialty vehicle insurance involves regulatory and product complexity that doesn't exist in standard auto. These are…
Real impact: You will have meaningful ownership. And what you do will likely materially impact the trajectory of our business over the next few years.
